title: Unisex Running – Mile One Was a Mistake. Embroidered Zip Hoodie
who: the runner who regrets the first mile every single time and laces up again anyway, zipped on for the cold start line and the cooldown walk.
art: A sweaty, wide-eyed runner in a headband, an orange striped jersey, navy shorts and striped socks runs hard on a dirt path past a wooden post, in orange, cream, navy and tan with a worn print texture.
headline: MILE ONE
inks: navy and brick red on Ash, cream and coral on Black and Navy
layout_story: MILE ONE runs above it and WAS A MISTAKE. below in two lines of heavy slab capitals, the last line wider than the first
layout_faq: MILE ONE above the runner and WAS A MISTAKE. below
chest: a small MISTAKE. wordmark in the same slab capitals as the back
warm2: cold start lines, early long runs and the cooldown walk home
gift_line: for the runner who swears off mile one and signs up for the next race.
seo_desc: A running zip up hoodie: MILE ONE WAS A MISTAKE. on the back over a sweaty runner mid-stride, plus stitched MISTAKE. lettering on the chest.
